report_metadata.title: GrowthLabs AI — Revenue Discovery Audit: API Test Client

key_findings.finding: Strong monthly growth rate of 17.0% — revenue is trending upward consistently.
key_findings.recommendation: Double down on what's working. Identify top-performing channels and allocate more budget.

key_findings.finding: 16% of customers (31) show early churn signals.
key_findings.recommendation: Proactive outreach to at-risk customers. Consider a check-in call or satisfaction survey.

key_findings.finding: Top-tier customers (Champions + Loyal) drive 84% of revenue — high dependency.
key_findings.recommendation: Nurture mid-tier customers to reduce concentration risk. Consider a loyalty program.

key_findings.finding: 'Referral' has the highest churn count (6 lost customers).
key_findings.recommendation: Review lead quality from this channel. Adjust targeting or reduce spend if ROI is negative.

key_findings.recommendation: Review cost structure for top revenue services. Consider price adjustments for low-margin offerings.
